action.description: Indicates that the operation will `identify` the the item of the specified `type`.

timestamp.description: The Unix timestamp for when the attribute update occurred. This can be used to control the order of attribute updates when multiple requests are sent in rapid succession.

attributes.description: Attributes that you want to add or update for this person. You can pass properties that aren't defined below to set custom attributes; the defined properties are reserved in the Customer.io Track API.

_update.description: If `true`, update only existing people and prevent accidental profile creation. If no person matches the identifiers, the request does nothing.

additionalProperties.description: Custom properties that you want to set as attributes on this person.

cio_id.description: A unique identifier set by Customer.io, used to reference a person if you want to update their identifiers.

cio_subscription_preferences.description: A person's [subscription center](/journeys/channels/subscriptions/center/) preferences. Use JSON dot notation, such as `cio_subscription_preferences.topics.topic_<id>`, to update one topic without replacing others.

topics.description: Contains active topics in your workspace, named `topic_<id>`.

additionalProperties.description: Boolean preference for a topic named `topic_<id>`; `true` subscribes, `false` unsubscribes, and empty or missing values use the topic default. Find topic IDs with [getTopics](#tag/subscription-center/getTopics).

not_nullable_customer_id.description: The ID of a customer profile, analogous to a "person" in the UI.

not_nullable_email_address.description: The email address of the customer.

identifiers.description: The identifiers for a particular object. You can use either the `object_type_id` and `object_id` (where `object_type_id` represents the type of object and the `object_id` is the individual identifier for the object) or the `cio_object_id`.

object_id.description: The unique identifier for an object. If you use an `object_id` that already exists, we'll update the object accordingly.

cio_object_id.description: A unique value that Customer.io sets for an object when you create it. This ID is immutable.

object_relationships.description: Each object in the array represents a relationship you want to add to, or remove from, a person.

object_type_id.description: The object type an object belongs to—like "Companies" or "Accounts". Object type IDs are string-formatted integers that begin at `1` and increment for each new type.

type.description: The operation modifies a person in Customer.io

identifiers.description: The person you want to perform an action for—one of `id`, `email`, `phone`, or `cio_id`. You cannot pass multiple identifiers. You can use `email` and `phone` only if they're enabled as identifiers in your [workspace settings](/accounts/workspaces/overview/#migrate-workspace).

phone.description: A person's phone number, in [E.164 format](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/E.164) (a leading `+` followed by up to 15 digits). Available only when `phone` is enabled as an identifier in your workspace.

relationship_attributes.description: The attributes associated with a relationship. Passing null or an empty string removes the attribute from the relationship.
